question: 按分支统计 2014 年 12 月 31 日持仓市值，列出前 5 名
expected_sql: SELECT db.Branch AS branch, SUM(fh.CurrentValue) AS holdings_value FROM atlas.dwd.fact_holdings fh JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_date dd ON fh.SK_DateID = dd.SK_DateID JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_account da ON fh.SK_AccountID = da.SK_AccountID JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_broker db ON da.SK_BrokerID = db.SK_BrokerID WHERE dd.DateValue = DATE '2014-12-31' GROUP BY db.Branch ORDER BY holdings_value DESC LIMIT 5

fibo_concepts.note: 持仓市值以货币金额度量
分支经账户托管关系归属(account→broker)
